paper_title: Search for dark matter particle interactions with electron final states with DarkSide-50
notes: Paper reports 90% C.L. exclusion limits on axioelectric coupling g_Ae for ALP absorption in liquid argon, for masses between 0.03 keV/c^2 and 0.2 keV/c^2 (30-200 eV). However, the numerical limit values are only shown graphically in Fig. 2 and not tabulated or given explicitly in the text, so no coupling data points could be extracted. The paper also constrains dark photon kinetic mixing (DarkPhoton), DM-electron cross section, and sterile neutrino mixing, but AxionElectron matches the hint.
